The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4775 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] between the [[Manderon Period]] and the [[Old Sith Wars]]. That year, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] brought an end to the [[Gank Massacres]], which had been raging for twenty-five years.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
